wishlist.wishers_intro:
These members have added you to their Acceptance List and chose to show you their Acceptance and they are currently not connected to other members.
There might be more members added you to their Acceptance List but they chose not to show their Acceptance ( mainly to avoid embarrassment ) and you may be matched with one of them if you Accepted that one.
There also could be members who have accepted you and chose to show you their Acceptance but they are currently connected to other members. You can not be matched with any of them unless he/she ends the communication with the other member.
wishlist.intro:
This list contains the persons you have accepted as possible future mate.

The Acceptance Matching will match you with one of your accepted persons only if he/she has added you to his/her Acceptance List.
Matching will pick the highest rank (in case of multiple mutual acceptances) then notifies both of you via e-mail to start communicating each others.

There is no chance of mutual acceptance if a member has not visited your page yet.

If one day has passed after the last visit from any of your accepted members without being matched with him/her, that means either he/she has not yet accepted you or he/she has been matched with someone else and they are still contacting each others.

There is no limit on how many persons you can add to your list. However, adding many persons to your list might reduce your chance to win those who have low ranks.
wishlist.ranking_desc: Note: the member with Rank 1 has more chance to be matched with than the following members.

wishlist.empty_list:
Your Acceptance List is currently empty.

You have no chance to be matched with any Kobool member untill you add that member to your Acceptance List

To add whoever is acceptable to you as a future mate, click on the "Acceptance" button found in that person profile page or in the %h1%Search%h0% results page.
